description: This file contains helper functions for manipulating 3D and 2D tables, such as curves and maps, used in control systems or tuning software. It includes functions to generate linear curves, RPM binning, table binning, and axis initialization.

methods.name: setLinearCurve
methods.description: Generates a linear interpolation curve from a start value to an end value, filling an array with interpolated and rounded values to a specified precision.

methods.name: setRpmBin
methods.description: Fills an array with RPM values spaced evenly between idling RPM and top RPM, with adjustments for the first and last bins.

methods.name: setTableBin
methods.description: Creates a linear table bin with a fixed precision between two values.

methods.name: setRpmTableBin
methods.description: Initializes an RPM table axis with a default RPM range from 800 to 7000.
